purpose: Observed HEBELTRADER featured-call selection criteria for a future Call-proposal module. Derived from publisher PDFs (esp. 199/26, 203/26), public Leseprobe 04/26, pdf-resolution-index WKNs, and onvista product terms. Not a trading recommendation.
policy: Stock identification and call selection remain separate stages.
Do not use featured WKNs as scan inputs for anonymous teasers.
Product terms at recommendation time come from the publisher PDF; live quote screens drift.
Issuer preference is opportunistic liquidity/terms, not a single house bank.

publisher_stated_process.source: Hebeltrader_2026-04_LESEPROBE.pdf page on Anlagegrundsätze / So handeln Sie
steps: Daily screening of a stock universe
Keep names with solid chart uptrend, supportive fundamentals, and stock-level CRV > 2
Then choose to trade the stock or a matching derivative
Derivative targets/stops derived from MA50/MA200 plus historical volatility

observed_product_template.instrument: classic Call Optionsschein (not Knock-Out/Turbo as primary pick)

issuer_pattern.selection_rule: Pick the liquid Call that best matches tenor/omega/OTM/CRV; rotate across major warrant issuers.

proposal_ranking_checklist: After stock ID is secured, search classic Calls only.
Prefer ~4–6 months to expiry (publisher label ≈ 5 Monate).
Prefer strike ~10–35% OTM vs Stand-Uhr spot.
Prefer conversion ratio 0.1 when available for the underlying.
Score by publisher-style CRV (Ziel-2 upside / stop risk); target ≥ ~12.
Require tradeable spread/liquidity; issuer may be any major house.
Exclude underlyings with an active featured call inside the 180-day lookback.
Independently verify ISIN/WKN, issuer terms, AT tradability, and risk before any suggestion.
limits: Full publisher-pdf extract corpus is gitignored; only 2 recent upload PDFs plus public Leseprobe have complete feature-time CRV/omega boxes in this run.
Onvista snapshots after feature date show drifted Omega; use PDF Stand Uhr for calibration.
WKN-prefix → issuer mapping for the full 133 inventory is heuristic except for the verified sample.
